name: Proofpoint click permitted - Okta sign-in from a different IP within 1 hour
xql_query:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _log_type = "click-permitted"
| fields recipient, clickIP, url, GUID, _time as clickTime
| join type = inner (
    datamodel dataset = okta_sso_raw
    | filter xdm.event.outcome = "SUCCESS" and xdm.source.ipv4 != null
    | fields xdm.source.user.upn as loginUser, xdm.source.ipv4 as loginIP,
             xdm.source.location.country as loginCountry, _time as loginTime) as okta
  okta.loginUser = recipient
| filter loginTime > clickTime
     and timestamp_diff(loginTime, clickTime, "MINUTE") <= 60
     and loginIP != clickIP
| comp count() as login_count, values(loginIP) as login_ips,
       values(loginCountry) as login_countries, min(loginTime) as first_login
  by GUID, recipient, clickIP, url, clickTime
description: A user clicked a Proofpoint click-permitted URL, then signed in to Okta from a different IP within 60 minutes. One issue per click.
alert_name: Proofpoint click permitted - Okta sign-in from a different IP within 1 hour
